items.text: Three persistence axes graduate along self->dwelling->collective->commons intimacy gradient: Reach (permission) / Delivery (economics) / Persistence (durability) + Recovery (restore); same people across all
Asserted->Attested->Ambient durability: substrate = N independent replicas with notarized/auditable contract + reciprocity-imbalance signal on holder lapse (verifiable beats claimed)

Subsume 3 web2 reliability functions: cloud uptime->tiered replication contracts + RS quilt + demand re-replication; institutional protection->pooled collective/commons tier + dissolution; account recovery->graduated recovery + socially-derived security

Live felt-durability surfaces: progressive icon (EprRelationshipCard<-ResilienceService), connection chip (ConnectionIndicator), per-device triptych (DeviceTile), cluster page (MyCluster), peer topology (PeerTopology), per-EPR Network tab (resilience.rs), per-content badge (ResourceExplorer)

Deterministic floor (gates vs allocation): 7-check bounds_validator, donut clamp + constitutional_ratio_registry, inventory sha256 verification, replication state machine, placement_gaps projection, household_resilience protection_status; cluster_view Category-C reconstruct per-request not persisted

Gap 1 - connective tissue/discoverability: add nav links to /shefa/cluster + /shefa/peers; link EPR mentions to content-viewer Network tab; free/used clickable bar (text->bar); consuming component for ResilienceSnapshotView/NetworkPostureView/TopologyOverviewView

Gap 2 - committed/constitutional accounting: replace peer_capacity_service stub readers (free/used reads zero); wire replication_prioritizer (currently dead code) into drain_gap_queue/inventory subscriber; donut/pledge accounting -> pledged-vs-held with storage-premium visible

Gap 3 - join elohim ceiling to floor for topology: grow wisdom.rs input shape (accepts only constitution/framing/event_summary) so agents can reason over placement-gaps/resilience-snapshots/inventory advertisements; keep gates in Rust, .ts sense-and-respond only

Recovery (third face): graduated recovery (intimate quorum->community->governance->global witness, Shamir optional); KeyRotation + 5 RecoveryAuthority layers in imagodei; same intimacy tiers hold-data and restore-access
